summary: An immaculate ground floor two bedroom property, benefitting from a private parking space and superbly located in the heart of the West End offering convenient access to local amenities.
description:
LOUNGE A spacious lounge featuring cream carpets throughout and offering ample room for sofas and additional furniture, complemented by double glazed windows that provide plenty of natural light.

KITCHEN A modern kitchen featuring spotlights set into the ceiling, white high gloss wall and base units, and a range of integrated and freestanding appliances including a washing machine. The kitchen is equipped with an electric oven, gas hob with extractor fan, and a sink basin with mixer tap, combining style with everyday practicality. There is also ample room for a table and chairs.

BEDROOM A well proportioned double bedroom offering ample space for wardrobes and additional furniture.

BEDROOM A comfortable second bedroom featuring fitted wardrobes, offering practical storage and a well arranged living space.

BATHROOM A neatly presented bathroom fitted with a three piece suite comprising a bath with shower head, WC, and wash hand basin offering a practical and well designed space.

EXTERNAL Externally, the property benefits from a designated private parking space and is conveniently located within walking distance of Darlington town centre and a range of local amenities.
